_about: MURAVES reconstruction parameters used ONLY by the simulation chain. They are merged on top of configuration/shared/reco_parameters.json and may not redefine its sections. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the code.

depth_correction._note: Method B, see muraves_lib/configuration/README.md: a 2-bar cluster is fitted at the depth Xc where the muon crosses the face shared by the two bars, Xc = -face_orientation * sign_k * (h/p) * (z_c - B), with k the lower strip, sign_k = +1 for k even, B the boundary of the pair; other cluster sizes keep Xc = 0. enabled: false gives exactly the reconstruction without depths.
depth_correction._face_orientation_note: Per hodoscope and view: +1 when an (even, odd) strip pair shares a '\' face (dz/dx ~ -0.97), as in the simulated geometry; -1 when mirrored; null = no depth for that hodoscope/view. The simulated geometry is +1 in both views (the data Y view is mirrored, see data/data_parameters.json).
